name: TensorPM v1.41.5
body:
# Changelog - v1.41.5

This update fixes a crash on the first start on Windows.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Windows: TensorPM starts again on a new installation:** on the first start, while the welcome
  and sign-in steps were shown, TensorPM could stop with "Something went wrong" right away, and
  restarting or "Try again" led to the same message. The first start now works as expected.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- **Updated components:** several built-in libraries (AI provider connections, document import and
  export, sync) were updated to their latest minor versions.

## 📝 Notes

- Version 1.41.4 was never published; this release replaces it.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.41.5
- **Release Date**: 2026-10-05
- **Previous Version**: 1.41.3
- **Type**: Patch Release (Hotfix)
